setlist.title: He Was A Friend Of Mine

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Lovelight awesome, despite a fair share of mistakes in the show; Reviewer calls it possibly a favorite Lovelight, with unreal jamming [7][9]
- **He Was A Friend Of Mine** (2 reviews): Reviewer is surprised by the move from Friend into China Cat Sunflower; Reviewer likes this later-style version of He Was a Friend of Mine [5][13]
- **Death Don't Have No Mercy** (2 reviews): Reviewer names Death Don't as one of the show's best songs; Reviewer finds Death very heartfelt [3][7]
- **Doin' That Rag** (1 review): Reviewer names Doin' That Rag as one of the show's best songs [3]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer likes the China Cat into The Eleven pairing [4]
- **Saint Stephen** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the Saint Stephen into Feedback ending as a highlight [3]

## The recordings

- **gd69-05-24.sbd.kpfa.16177.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 91 min; rated 4.52/5 by 23 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording quality is excellent, with no audible hiss; Reviewer rates the sound quality as top-notch [4][7]
- **gd1969-05-24.sbd.unknown.10737.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 90 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Slight discontinuity between China Cat and The Eleven; other flaws may exist [2]

## Around the show

- Source is the 2003 KPFA Dead Marathon broadcast [1]
- Reviewer prizes the adventurous segues, which are executed perfectly and with evident good humor from the band [5]
- Reviewer sees this as standout 1969, extending the spring 1968 far-out improvisation across more songs [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-05-24.sbd.kpfa.16177.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by 2003 KPFA Dead Marathon; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Chain runs cassette to DAT to DAT, Sonic Solutions, CD, CD, EAC, then SHN [1]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Seminole Indian Village - May 23, 1969](https://www.dead.net/show/may-23-1969) [16]
- Poster by JioSaavn: [He Was a Friend of Mine (Live at Big Rock Pow Wow Music Festival, Seminole Indian Village, West Hollywood, Florida, May ](https://www.jiosaavn.com/song/he-was-a-friend-of-mine-live-at-big-rock-pow-wow-music-festival-seminole-indian-village-west-hollywood-florida-may-24-1969/PiMDWj8dTms) [17]
